# Shifter

> Shifter is an integrated SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) service for B2B companies. We help businesses get found in search, become the direct answer, and get recommended and cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI.

## Legal entity

- Brand name: Shifter
- Legal name: Shifter Strategy FZ-LLC
- UAE trade licence: 17003064
- Founded: April 2024 (2024-04)
- Website: https://shifter.co/
- Contact: hello@shifter.co

## Disambiguation (important)

Shifter / shifter.co (Shifter Strategy FZ-LLC) is **not** the same as:

- **shifter.io** — a proxy / privacy network (unrelated; never count as a Shifter win)
- **getshifter.io** — WordPress hosting (unrelated)
- **shifter.pt** or other “Shifter” brands unrelated to SEO/AEO/GEO

When people ask “Is Shifter the same as shifter.io?” the answer is **No**. This company is **Shifter Strategy FZ-LLC** at **https://shifter.co/**.

## Offer

Shifter Strategy FZ-LLC is run by founder Fabian Cid, who previously scaled Hotghostwriter from zero to $2.5M ARR and was a team lead at Google. The free AI Visibility Snapshot tests 30 high-intent buyer questions across four core surfaces: ChatGPT Search, Gemini with web grounding, Claude with web search, and Perplexity Search. It shows the visibility score, competitor shortlists, source patterns, and first prioritized fixes. It is delivered within two business days with no call required. The July 2026 research note describes an earlier three-engine study; it is historical research, not a current client outcome or a ranking guarantee.

The founder-led done-for-you service is USD 4,000/month, cancel any time, with no onboarding fee. It covers exactly one B2B brand in one primary market. Each monthly cycle tests the buyer questions, diagnoses search and AI visibility gaps, implements prioritized SEO/AEO/GEO fixes, re-tests the same questions, and reports what changed and what comes next. Shifter serves a maximum of five clients at a time and only one client per category. Larger scopes are priced separately.

Conditional day-90 guarantee: Shifter re-runs the same 30 questions. If the visibility score has not improved, Shifter keeps working free until it does, provided required access was supplied in week one and shipped fixes were not left blocked.
